stations.title: Ravi
stations.say: Can Moss keep up a long chat?
stations.note: Two problems in the chat logs.

stations.title: Chat history
stations.text: Grows by two messages every turn.
stations.note: Today it is not even kept.

stations.title: Moss
stations.note: It refuses a request that is too big.

captions: Customers chat with Moss now. Ravi finds long chats going wrong in the logs.
Moss forgets each turn, and once a chat grows too long, every message gets Error.
You write the history and the trimming, in three tasks.
Now Moss remembers recent turns, and every request fits the budget.
Same long chat, still answered. Moss is ready for real customers.
